preconditions.description: The length of arrays a and b are between 1 and 2 * 10^5.
Each element in array a is between 1 and 10^9.
Each element in array b is between 1 and 10^9 and is in strictly increasing order.

postconditions.expression: output == number of ways to divide array a into m consecutive subarrays such that the minimum of each subarray is equal to the corresponding element in array b
postconditions.description: The output is the number of ways to divide array a into m consecutive subarrays such that the minimum of each subarray is equal to the corresponding element in array b, modulo 998244353.
